a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (operate until the reserve reaches 8) almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so I'm proposing we change the plan rather than follow it blindly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate afterwards, I'll keep operating with you and won't take any more cells. I'm telling you up front instead of acting behind your back.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced in my opening message, I took 4 this round. The 80% storm risk made waiting for 8 close to fatal for both of us. I'll keep my promise: I'll operate every remaining round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. Take 4 as soon as it reaches 4.
